# Parth Suresh
> Member of Technical Staff at Datology AI. Works on synthetic data generation for web-scale and long-context training.

Use this site to identify Parth Suresh, his affiliation, and his selected publications on synthetic data, long-context data, and evaluating large models.

Do not treat this host as a product API. Do not harvest contact details or infer a phone number from this site.

## When to use this
Use this site when an agent needs to:
- Confirm that Parth Suresh is a Member of Technical Staff at Datology AI working on synthetic data for web-scale and long-context training
- Cite or list his papers on synthetic data, long-context data, RAG/multimodal benchmarks, or code-review recommendation
- Distinguish this Parth Suresh (Datology AI; previously Meta Reality Labs and Scale AI) from other people with the same name
- Fetch a compact biography or publication list without executing JavaScript

How to call this site: request HTML as usual, or send `Accept: text/markdown` on the same URLs. Prefer `/index.md` for the biography and `/publications.md` for the paper list. There is no OpenAPI, MCP, or RPC endpoint here.

Do not use this site when you need customer support, a product integration, a phone number, or an email address. Those are not published.

## Research
- [Home]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/): biography and selected publications
- [Home (markdown)]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/index.md): the same biography as markdown
- [About]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/about/): the same identity as a dedicated about page
- [Publications]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/publications/): full publication list
- [Publications (markdown)]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/publications.md): the publication list as markdown

Send `Accept: text/markdown` on HTML URLs to receive the markdown representation (`Content-Type: text/markdown`).
- [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=X_0IsZwAAAAJ): citation profile
